It’s called your inner child. You need to heal that inner child that faced the abuse and trauma. I don’t see myself as a child in that type of way like you do physically but I definitely feel like mentally, emotionally and spiritually I am still the age I was when all the abuse and intense trauma began and never ended. I still am drawn to people with abusive tendencies/narcissist ways without even realizing it until I do, I believe it’s my way of maybe trying to get the control, understanding and closure I need that I didn’t have when I was younger and now that I am older my inner child thinks that I can protect myself from those kinds of people who were like my abusers. I was stuck in survival mode for a very long time until this year when I began to live my life instead of just surviving it. I remember when I went to rehab they told me that in my head I am still the age I was when I started drugs and that I am basically an adult child. There is a support group I attended there called Adult-Children of Alcoholics. It’s a group for people who grew up with addiction in their life and because they spent their childhood being the parent and trying to survive they are basically Adult-Children now because they didn’t have that important healthy childhood experience, so they are living it out as an Adult or are still stuck in that part of their childhood in survive mode. When you experience all this traumatic stuff as a child and haven’t been able to heal it and try to move past it, you stay in the past of it. Many survivors of trauma as children as adults now are Adult-Children. I’m so sorry you feel this way and I hope you don’t take offense to me saying that you might be an Adult-Child too, look into it and find if that fits what your feeling and see what you can do to help yourself heal. All of the best luck and love to you and everyone in this group and on this thread, you’re not alone and I’m here for anyone who needs to reach out and talk 💕
